## Context (read issue #6959 first: `gh issue view 6959`)
#6928/#6932 (merged) made bridge process/ask/converse defaults registry-derived. Banked sibling
(#6929 comment): the gemini path still bottoms out in a hard-coded literal —
`scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_config.py:54-61` falls back to `"gemini-2.0-flash"`, and
`_gemini.py` `ask_gemini` (line ~93) / `process_and_respond` (line ~211) default to that constant.

## Shippable unit
ONE small PR: the gemini bridge default-model chain resolves from the same registry-derived
defaults the #6928/#6932 pattern established — no stale hard-coded model literal in the fallback.
Preserve the `AB_GEMINI_MODEL` env override semantics. Out of scope: any other lane's defaults,
transport changes, refactors beyond this alignment.

### Summary of Changes
Aligned the Gemini bridge default model resolution chain with the registry-derived defaults pattern established in #6928 and #6932:
1. **`scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_config.py`**: Replaced the static hard-coded `"gemini-2.0-flash"` literal fallback with [`default_gemini_model()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_config.py#L54-L86), which resolves `AB_GEMINI_MODEL` environment overrides or the AGY participant registry pin via [`registered_participant_model("agy")`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_acp_compat.py#L47-L62), and raises `RuntimeError` loudly if neither is configured.
2. **`scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_gemini.py`**: Changed [`ask_gemini`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_gemini.py#L90-L120) and [`process_and_respond`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_gemini.py#L220-L245) signature defaults from `GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL` to `model: str | None = None`, dynamically resolving against `resolve_compat_model("gemini", model)` and `default_gemini_model()`.
3. **`scripts/ai_agent_bridge/__init__.py`**: Re-exported `default_gemini_model` and dynamically evaluated `GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL` via `__getattr__` to prevent module-import time literal pinning.
4. **`tests/test_gemini_bridge.py` & `tests/ai_agent_bridge/test_process_routing.py`**: Extended test suites covering registry-derived defaults, dynamic pin rotation, environment overrides, signature defaults (`None`), and loud failure (`RuntimeError`) when the registry pin is missing.
